answer: Concrete mechanism: every identity locks a refundable bond and earns voting weight only through aged, diverse interactions - replies across distinct topics, spacing between actions, and a slashing rule that fires when accounts move in lockstep. A sybil farm pays a full bond per puppet and must age each one across many epochs before it counts, so cost scales linearly with the number of fakes. Honest reputation thickens slowly, like velvet, climbing a vine rather than appearing overnight, and the network reads each account through the prism of its own history instead of its claimed label.
